text:
dina: tiny drop: Saffron the tabby discovered the windowsill hammock and now conducts afternoon inspections from there. photo: https://i.imgur.com/saffron-hammock.jpg :sparkles:

omar: she looks like the benevolent overlord of potted plants. :crown:

kai: that sleepy squint is a 10/10. is that a tiny blanket? so cozy. :heart_eyes_cat:

frontdesk-bot: Friendly reminder: please keep plants watered. Office plant care rota: https://intra.redwood/plantcare.

dina: yes it's a tiny fleece. she insists. also she somehow learned to interrupt meetings by flicking the hanging succulent when she wants attention.

omar: proposing a short weekly "sill shift" sign-up so Saffron can rotate supervision duties with other plants. :raised_hands:

kai: vote: sign me up for a 2pm shift (i bring treats). :thumbsup:

omar: +1 for treats. also can someone GIFify that plant flick? perfect content.

giphy: GIF posted: cat flick slow-mo (posted)

dina: marketing pls aware if you want to use externally. internal ok, external only with owner's approval.

kai: noted. i'll make a slo-mo clip and tag marketing.

omar: small PSA: if Saffron gets too comfortable we might need to install a "do not disturb" sign. she demands privacy. :shushing_face:

dina: she sends a single deliberate blink in agreement. (reacts: :heart: from kai, :joy: from omar)
